en.title: Snail mail club subscriber tracker
en.summary: Keep a growing snail-mail club list straight: resubscribes, cancellations, new members, addresses, and dates—without the spreadsheet chaos.
en.whyItWorks: Membership churn and address changes pile up fast. Routing those updates through a dedicated Grok Bot turns messy back-and-forth into a single intake path so status, addresses, and dates stay in one place.
workflowSteps: List the membership events you need to track: new subscribers, resubscribes, cancellations, address changes, and key dates.
Create a Grok Bot whose job is only club roster ops—ask it to maintain a structured member record (name, address, status, last update).
Point club email or form replies at the bot (forward or bot inbox) so every change lands in one thread.
Have the bot confirm the interpreted change (status + address + date) before you treat it as final.
Ask for a weekly roster digest: active, canceled, and pending updates.
en.promptTemplate:
You are my snail-mail club roster assistant.

Maintain a structured member list with: name, mailing address, status (active / canceled / pending), subscribe date, last change date, and notes.

When I send a message about a member (new signup, resubscribe, cancel, address change):
1) Parse the intent and fields.
2) Show the proposed record update.
3) Ask me to confirm before saving.
4) After confirm, acknowledge the new status.

On request, output a roster summary grouped by status.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Use the bot inbox or Gmail forward for signup/cancel emails. Optional daily or weekly routine: “Summarize roster changes since last digest.” Keep human confirm on status changes that affect mailing.

setupSteps.title: List the membership events to track
setupSteps.detail: New subscribers, resubscribes, cancellations, address changes, and key dates.

setupSteps.title: Create a bot whose only job is the club roster
setupSteps.detail: Send the prompt template on this page. Fields: name, mailing address, status (active, canceled, or pending), subscribe date, last change date, and notes. Connectors this case lists: Bot inbox, Gmail, and Routine (on message).

setupSteps.title: Point club email or form replies at the bot
setupSteps.detail: Forward, or use the bot inbox, so every change lands in one thread. Signup and cancel emails can go through the bot inbox or a Gmail forward.

setupSteps.title: Confirm the interpreted change before it is final
setupSteps.detail: The bot shows the proposed record update and asks you to confirm before saving, then acknowledges the new status. Status changes that affect mailing stay human-confirmed.

setupSteps.title: Ask for a roster summary
setupSteps.detail: Members grouped by status: active, canceled, and pending. Optional daily or weekly routine: “Summarize roster changes since last digest.”

acceptanceChecklist: A new signup, resubscribe, cancellation, or address change is parsed into a member record with name, mailing address, status (active, canceled, or pending), subscribe date, last change date, and notes.
The bot shows the proposed record update and asks you to confirm before saving.
After you confirm, it acknowledges the new status.
When you ask for a roster summary, members are grouped by status: active, canceled, and pending.
When the optional daily or weekly routine runs, it summarizes roster changes since the last digest.

zh.title: 实体信件社订阅者追踪
zh.summary: 把不断增长的实体信件社名单理顺：续订、退订、新会员、地址与日期，不再靠混乱表格硬扛。
zh.whyItWorks: 会员变动与地址更新来得很快。把这些变更统一交给专用 Grok Bot 处理，能把零散沟通收成一条入口，状态、地址和日期都落在同一处。
workflowSteps: 先列出要跟踪的会员事件：新订阅、续订、退订、地址变更和关键日期。
创建只负责社群名册的 Grok Bot，要求它维护结构化会员记录（姓名、地址、状态、最近更新）。
把社群邮件或表单回复指向该 Bot（转发或 Bot 收件箱），让所有变更进同一通道。
让 Bot 在你确认前复述即将写入的变更（状态 + 地址 + 日期）。
定期索取名册摘要：在订、已退、待处理更新。
zh.promptTemplate:
你是我的实体信件社名册助手。

请维护结构化会员列表，字段包括：姓名、邮寄地址、状态（在订/已退/待处理）、订阅日期、最近变更日期、备注。

当我发来与会员相关的消息（新订、续订、退订、改地址）时：
1）解析意图与字段；
2）展示拟更新的记录；
3）请我确认后再保存；
4）确认后回执新状态。

按要求输出按状态分组的名册摘要。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 用 Bot 收件箱或 Gmail 转发承接订阅/退订邮件。可选每日或每周例行：「汇总自上份摘要以来的名册变更」。涉及邮寄的状态变更保留人工确认。

setupSteps.title: 列出要跟踪的会员事件
setupSteps.detail: 新订阅、续订、退订、地址变更和关键日期。

setupSteps.title: 创建一个只负责社群名册的 Bot
setupSteps.detail: 把本页的提示词模板发给它。字段：姓名、邮寄地址、状态（在订、已退或待处理）、订阅日期、最近变更日期、备注。本案例列出的连接器：Bot inbox、Gmail、Routine (on message)。

setupSteps.title: 把社群邮件或表单回复指向该 Bot
setupSteps.detail: 转发或使用 Bot 收件箱，让所有变更进同一通道。订阅和退订邮件可以走 Bot 收件箱或 Gmail 转发。

setupSteps.title: 确认 Bot 复述的变更之后，再当作最终记录
setupSteps.detail: Bot 会展示拟更新的记录，保存前请你确认，确认后回执新状态。涉及邮寄的状态变更保留人工确认。

setupSteps.title: 索取按状态分组的名册摘要
setupSteps.detail: 在订、已退、待处理。可选每日或每周例行：「汇总自上份摘要以来的名册变更。」

acceptanceChecklist: 新订、续订、退订或地址变更会被解析成会员记录，包含姓名、邮寄地址、状态（在订、已退或待处理）、订阅日期、最近变更日期和备注。
Bot 会展示拟更新的记录，并在保存前请你确认。
你确认之后，它会回执新状态。
索取名册摘要时，会员会按状态分组：在订、已退、待处理。
可选的每日或每周例行运行时，会汇总自上份摘要以来的名册变更。
